{{Top|leg}}
The '''Outbound Dome''' was one of the large spherical modules of the [[Kuat Passenger Port]]. It was responsible for dealing with flights originating from, and heading towards, destinations outside of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Due to [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighters]] requiring travel permits to enter the Core Worlds, flights heading to other destinations were keep separate from the dedicated Core Worlds traffic.
